extracted.name: Ras el Hanout
extracted.description: Ras el hanout is a spice mix with ground cumin, ginger, turmeric, cinnamon, coriander, pepper, and more, that's used in many Moroccan dishes.
instruction_lines: Mix salt, cumin, ginger, turmeric, cinnamon, black pepper, white pepper, coriander, cayenne, allspice, nutmeg, and cloves in a small bowl until evenly blended. Store in an airtight container for up to 1 month.
